image_prompts: A jack-in-the-box toy with a clown popping out, confetti flying
A winding road with a 'Detour' sign suddenly appearing around a bend
words.image_desc_en: An event or situation that was not anticipated.
words.image_desc_cn: 未预料到的事件或情况。
words.meaning_cn: adj. 意想不到的，出乎意料的
words.collocations: unexpected result, unexpected guest, unexpected news

examples.en: The sudden rain was an unexpected surprise during our picnic.
examples.cn: 突如其来的雨是我们在野餐时意想不到的惊喜。

examples.en: His unexpected visit made my day much brighter and happier.
examples.cn: 他意想不到的来访让我的日子更加光明和快乐。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你没有预料到某件事会发生，它对你来说是怎样的？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 表示没有提前想到，突然发生。

sentences: The power outage was completely ___ and disrupted our evening plans.

image_prompts: A clock showing 11:59 PM, with fireworks ready to launch at midnight
A finish line with a runner just about to cross it, stopwatch showing a close time
words.image_desc_en: A moment right before a deadline or event.
words.image_desc_cn: 截止时间或事件发生前的瞬间。
words.collocations: by the time + clause

examples.en: By the time I got to school, the bell had already rung.
examples.cn: 到我到达学校的时候，铃声已经响过了。

examples.en: By the time she finishes her homework, it will be quite late.
examples.cn: 到她完成作业的时候，时间会很晚了。

socratic_questions.question: 你计划在某个特定时刻之前完成某件事，用哪个短语来表达“到那个时刻”？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个短语表示一个时间节点，在它之前事情已经发生或将会发生。

sentences: ___ we arrived at the cinema, the movie had already started.

image_prompts: A brightly colored backpack lying on a wooden floor, school supplies scattered around it
An empty backpack hanging on a hook against a plain white wall, side view
words.image_desc_en: A bag carried on the back with straps.
words.image_desc_cn: 一种用带子背在背上的包。
words.collocations: carry a backpack, pack a backpack
words.preposition_combos: in a backpack, on a backpack

examples.en: I always carry a heavy backpack full of books to school.
examples.cn: 我总是背着装满书的沉重背包去学校。

examples.en: She packed her backpack with snacks and water for the hike.
examples.cn: 她把背包里装满了零食和水，准备去徒步旅行。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你需要携带很多东西，并且想解放双手，你会选择哪种包？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这种包可以背在背上，减轻负担。

sentences: He always keeps a water bottle in his ___ when hiking.

image_prompts: An alarm clock lying on a nightstand, displaying a time much later than expected
A messy bed with rumpled sheets and a pillow on the floor, sunlight streaming through the window
words.image_desc_en: An alarm clock showing a late time and a messy bed.
words.image_desc_cn: 闹钟显示很晚的时间，以及一张凌乱的床。
words.usage: v. (过去式 overslept, 过去分词 overslept)
words.collocations: oversleep badly, oversleep seriously

examples.en: I often oversleep on weekends because I don't have to work.
examples.cn: 我周末经常睡过头，因为我不用工作。

examples.en: She overslept this morning and missed the important meeting at work.
examples.cn: 她今天早上睡过头了，错过了工作中重要的会议。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你原本打算早起，但醒来时发现已经比计划晚了很多，这是什么情况？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 比预期睡眠时间更长，导致错过原本计划的事情。

sentences: He ___ and missed his flight to New York City.

image_prompts: An open hand presenting a wrapped gift box with a ribbon
A vending machine dispensing a can of soda after money is inserted
words.image_desc_en: A hand offering a gift; a vending machine dispensing a drink.
words.image_desc_cn: 一只手递出礼物；一台自动售货机售出饮料。
words.collocations: give a gift, give advice, give a speech

examples.en: Could you give me some advice about my English study, please?
examples.cn: 你能给我一些关于我英语学习的建议吗？

examples.en: I will give this book to my friend as a birthday present.
examples.cn: 我将把这本书作为生日礼物送给我的朋友。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你想把你的旧玩具送给你的弟弟，你会做什么动作？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个动作表示把东西交给别人。

sentences: Please ___ me a call when you arrive at the station.

image_prompts: A concert ticket with a large red 'SOLD OUT' stamp across it
Empty shelves in a store where a popular product used to be displayed
words.image_desc_en: Visuals representing the concept of 'sell out', indicating complete depletion of stock or tickets.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表“售罄”概念的视觉效果，表明库存或门票已完全耗尽。
words.usage: v. (过去式 sold out, 过去分词 sold out)
words.collocations: sell out of (something), sell out quickly, sell out completely

examples.en: The tickets for the concert sold out in just a few hours.
examples.cn: 音乐会的门票在短短几个小时内就售罄了。

examples.en: The limited edition sneakers sold out almost immediately after release.
examples.cn: 限量版运动鞋在发布后几乎立即售罄。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你想买演唱会门票，但被告知已经没有了，这种情况用英语怎么说？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 表示所有门票都已卖光。

sentences: The new phone model is so popular that it will probably ___ soon.

image_prompts: A magnifying glass over an ancient map, revealing a new continent
A telescope pointed at the night sky, revealing a previously unseen galaxy
words.image_desc_en: Visual representations of making a new discovery.
words.image_desc_cn: 发现新事物的视觉呈现。
words.collocations: make a discovery, important discovery, accidental discovery

examples.en: His discovery of the new species was a major breakthrough.
examples.cn: 他对这个新物种的发现是一个重大的突破。

examples.en: The discovery of penicillin changed medicine forever in the world.
examples.cn: 青霉素的发现永远地改变了世界医学。

socratic_questions.question: 科学家们常常会找到一些以前人们不知道的东西，这叫做什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 找到新事物，之前未知。

sentences: The ___ of the tomb revealed many ancient artifacts to the public.

image_prompts: An elegant antique brooch with intricate floral designs
A vintage hat with a wide brim and delicate lace details
words.image_desc_en: An elegant brooch and a vintage hat.
words.image_desc_cn: 一枚优雅的胸针和一顶复古帽子。
words.collocations: young lady, old lady, first lady

examples.en: The kind lady helped me find my lost cat yesterday.
examples.cn: 昨天那位好心的女士帮助我找到了我丢失的猫。

examples.en: She is a very polite lady with excellent manners at dinner.
examples.cn: 她是一位非常有礼貌的女士，在晚餐时表现出极佳的举止。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你在公共场合需要寻求帮助，你会称呼一位成年女性什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这是一个表示尊重和礼貌的称呼。

sentences: The ___ in the red dress is a famous writer.

image_prompts: A red 'X' mark stamped over a calendar date, indicating cancellation
A flight information board displaying 'CANCELLED' in large red letters
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations depicting the concept of cancellation.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘“取消”概念的插图。
words.usage: v. (cancelled, cancelled) to decide that an arranged event will not happen
words.collocations: cancel a meeting, cancel an order, cancel a subscription

examples.en: We had to cancel our trip because of the heavy rain.
examples.cn: 因为大雨，我们不得不取消旅行。

examples.en: The school decided to cancel classes due to the severe weather.
examples.cn: 学校决定因为恶劣天气取消课程。

socratic_questions.question: 如果原本计划好的活动因为突发情况无法进行，你会怎么做？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 考虑使用一个表示“停止进行”的动词。

sentences: They had to ___ the concert because the singer was ill.

image_prompts: A police badge with a star emblem on a dark leather background
A navy ship's bridge with various control panels and communication devices
words.image_desc_en: A police badge and a navy ship's bridge.
words.image_desc_cn: 警徽和海军舰艇的舰桥。
words.collocations: police officer, army officer, customs officer

examples.en: The police officer helped the lost child find his parents quickly.
examples.cn: 那位警官帮助迷路的孩子很快找到了他的父母。

examples.en: He is a customs officer at the airport, checking every suitcase.
examples.cn: 他是一名在机场的海关官员，检查每一个行李箱。

socratic_questions.question: 谁负责维持公共秩序，逮捕罪犯？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个人通常穿着制服，佩戴徽章。

sentences: The security ___ asked to see my identification card at the entrance.

image_prompts: A stack of books with a magnifying glass focusing on the word 'truth'
A movie scene with special effects that seamlessly blend with reality
words.image_desc_en: Books with 'truth' highlighted; a realistic movie scene.
words.image_desc_cn: 突出“真相”的书籍；逼真的电影场景。
words.collocations: believable story, believable character, believable excuse

examples.en: The story she told about the lost dog was quite believable.
examples.cn: 她讲的关于丢失的狗的故事非常可信。

examples.en: His excuse for being late to school wasn't very believable.
examples.cn: 他上学迟到的理由不是很令人信服。

socratic_questions.question: 如果有人告诉你一个故事，你觉得它很真实，你会用什么词来形容这个故事？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示某事听起来像是真的，可以让人相信。

sentences: The actor gave a ___ performance, making the audience believe his role.

image_prompts: A magic trick with a white rabbit vanishing from a top hat, smoke effect
A sandcastle being washed away by ocean waves, leaving a smooth beach
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations showing the concept of something vanishing or fading away.
words.image_desc_cn: 展示某物消失或逐渐消失的概念的插图。
words.usage: v. (过去式 disappeared, 过去分词 disappeared)
words.collocations: suddenly disappear, gradually disappear

examples.en: The old cinema began to disappear from our memories slowly.
examples.cn: 那家老电影院开始慢慢地从我们的记忆中消失。

examples.en: My favorite pen seemed to disappear after I lent it to him.
examples.cn: 我最喜欢的钢笔借给他之后好像不见了。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你把一块冰放在阳光下，会发生什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 冰会融化，然后不再能被看见。

sentences: The stars ___ behind the clouds as the storm approached.

image_prompts: A spotlight shining on an empty stage, a single microphone stand
A person tripping over their own shoelaces in a public space, items scattered around
words.image_desc_en: A situation causing discomfort and self-consciousness.
words.image_desc_cn: 引起不适和自我意识的情况。
words.usage: adj. causing someone to feel awkward, self-conscious, or ashamed
words.collocations: embarrassing moment, embarrassing situation, find it embarrassing

examples.en: It was so embarrassing when I forgot my lines in the play.
examples.cn: 我在戏剧中忘记台词时，真是太尴尬了。

examples.en: He told an embarrassing story about his childhood to everyone.
examples.cn: 他向所有人讲述了一个关于他童年的令人尴尬的故事。

socratic_questions.question: 想象一下，你在全班同学面前摔倒了，你会感觉怎么样？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 描述的是一种让你感觉不舒服，想躲起来的情绪。

sentences: It was very ___ when I realized I had worn mismatched shoes.

image_prompts: A panoramic view of snow-capped mountains reflecting in a clear blue lake, New Zealand landscape
A green pasture with sheep grazing, rolling hills in the background, New Zealand countryside
words.image_desc_en: Scenic landscapes of New Zealand, featuring mountains, lakes, and pastures.
words.image_desc_cn: 新西兰的风景，包括山脉、湖泊和牧场。
words.collocations: visit New Zealand, travel to New Zealand, from New Zealand
words.preposition_combos: in New Zealand, to New Zealand, from New Zealand

examples.en: I hope to visit New Zealand during my next summer vacation.
examples.cn: 我希望在下一个暑假访问新西兰。

examples.en: She bought a beautiful souvenir when she traveled to New Zealand.
examples.cn: 她去新西兰旅行时买了一个漂亮的纪念品。

socratic_questions.question: 哪个国家以其壮丽的自然风光和毛利文化而闻名？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个国家位于澳大利亚的东南方，以kiwi鸟和蹦极运动而闻名。

sentences: ___ is famous for its beautiful scenery and adventure sports.

image_prompts: A map highlighting the boot-shaped peninsula of Italy in Europe
A collage of iconic Italian landmarks: the Colosseum, Leaning Tower of Pisa, and Venice canals
words.image_desc_en: A map of Italy and a collage of Italian landmarks.
words.image_desc_cn: 意大利地图和意大利地标的拼贴画。
words.collocations: visit Italy, southern Italy, northern Italy
words.preposition_combos: in Italy, to Italy, from Italy

examples.en: My family plans to travel to Italy next summer vacation.
examples.cn: 我的家人计划明年暑假去意大利旅行。

examples.en: She studied art history in Italy for six months last year.
examples.cn: 她去年在意大利学习了六个月的艺术史。

socratic_questions.question: 哪个欧洲国家以其美味的披萨、面条和历史悠久的罗马斗兽场而闻名？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个国家位于地中海，形状像一只靴子。

sentences: Rome, the capital of ___, is a city full of ancient ruins.

image_prompts: A red planet with visible craters and a thin atmosphere, stars in the background
A robotic rover exploring a rocky, red landscape under a pale sun
words.image_desc_en: Images depicting the planet Mars, its surface, and robotic exploration.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘火星、其表面以及机器人探索的图像。
words.collocations: explore Mars, visit Mars, on Mars
words.preposition_combos: on Mars, to Mars, from Mars

examples.en: Scientists hope to find evidence of life on Mars someday.
examples.cn: 科学家们希望有一天能在火星上找到生命存在的证据。

examples.en: The rover sent back amazing pictures from the surface of Mars.
examples.cn: 探测车从火星表面发回了令人惊叹的照片。

socratic_questions.question: 哪个星球被称为“红色星球”，并且是人类探索的目标之一？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个星球是太阳系中的一个行星，以其红色的外观而闻名。

sentences: ___ is the fourth planet from the Sun in our solar system.

image_prompts: A stack of grey concrete blocks arranged neatly on a construction site
A wooden toy block with the letter 'A' painted on its surface
words.image_desc_en: Concrete blocks and a wooden toy block.
words.image_desc_cn: 混凝土砌块和木制玩具积木。
words.meaning_cn: n. 街区；块；障碍物 v. 阻挡；阻塞
words.collocations: city block, block the road, building block

examples.en: Our school is located in a quiet residential block.
examples.cn: 我们的学校位于一个安静的住宅区。

examples.en: The fallen tree blocked the road after the heavy storm.
examples.cn: 暴风雨过后，倒下的树木阻挡了道路。

socratic_questions.question: 如果一条路被东西挡住了，车过不去，你会用哪个词来描述这个状态？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示“阻碍”的意思。

sentences: The police decided to ___ off the street due to the accident.

image_prompts: A row of dominoes perfectly aligned, ready to fall sequentially
A compass pointing north, aligned with a map showing the same direction
words.image_desc_en: Dominoes aligned in a row; a compass aligned with a map.
words.image_desc_cn: 一排多米诺骨牌完美对齐；一个指南针与地图方向一致。
words.collocations: be in line with, keep in line with

examples.en: Our actions should be in line with the school rules.
examples.cn: 我们的行为应该与学校的规章制度保持一致。

examples.en: The new policy is in line with the company's goals.
examples.cn: 新政策符合公司的目标。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你的观点和大家的想法很接近，你可以说你的观点是和什么一致？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 表示观点、行动与某种标准或目标相符。

sentences: The design of the building is ___ the latest trends in architecture.

image_prompts: A silhouette of a construction worker holding a blueprint against a sunrise
A factory assembly line with robotic arms welding metal parts, sparks flying
words.image_desc_en: Images depicting the concept of a worker through construction and factory settings.
words.image_desc_cn: 通过建筑和工厂场景描绘工人概念的图像。
words.collocations: factory worker, construction worker, hard worker
words.preposition_combos: worker in, worker at, worker for

examples.en: The factory needs more workers to increase its production output.
examples.cn: 这家工厂需要更多的工人来提高其生产产量。

examples.en: My father is a hard worker; he always puts in extra hours.
examples.cn: 我的父亲是一个勤奋的工人；他总是加班。

socratic_questions.question: 在建筑工地或工厂里，我们通常称那些进行实际操作的人为什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 指从事体力或脑力劳动，为组织或企业服务的人。

sentences: The company hired several new ___ to help with the increased workload.

image_prompts: A pair of wide, unblinking eyes intensely focused on a bright light
A magnifying glass hovering over a tiny object, revealing intricate details
words.image_desc_en: Visual representations of intense, prolonged looking.
words.image_desc_cn: 对某物长时间、专注地观看的视觉呈现。
words.usage: v. (过去式 stared, 过去分词 stared)
words.collocations: stare at, stare blankly, stare in amazement

examples.en: Don't stare at others; it's impolite, especially in public places.
examples.cn: 不要盯着别人看；这很不礼貌，尤其是在公共场合。

examples.en: I couldn't help but stare at the beautiful sunset over the ocean.
examples.cn: 我忍不住盯着海面上美丽的日落。

socratic_questions.question: 当你看到非常惊讶或奇怪的事情时，你会做什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 长时间地、睁大眼睛地看。

sentences: He began to ___ at the screen, his mind far away.

image_prompts: A person's face with wide eyes and an open mouth, expressing shock and disbelief.
A crumpled newspaper with a headline announcing an unbelievable event.
words.image_desc_en: Images depicting shock and incredulity.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘震惊和怀疑的图像。
words.collocations: utter disbelief, express disbelief, look in disbelief

examples.en: She stared at the test results in complete disbelief. It was unbelievable.
examples.cn: 她完全不相信地盯着考试结果。这令人难以置信。

examples.en: His excuse for being late was met with general disbelief from everyone.
examples.cn: 他迟到的借口遭到了所有人的普遍怀疑。

socratic_questions.question: 当你听到一个非常离奇的故事，你脸上会是什么表情？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个表情表达了你对这个故事真实性的怀疑。

sentences: The audience gasped in ___ when the magician made the rabbit disappear.

image_prompts: A hot air balloon floating high in the sky, clouds scattered around it
A shelf with books and a framed picture placed on the wall above it
words.image_desc_en: A hot air balloon floating high in the sky; A picture above a shelf.
words.image_desc_cn: 热气球漂浮在高空；书架上方的照片。
words.collocations: above average, above all, from above

examples.en: The sun rose above the mountains, painting the sky orange.
examples.cn: 太阳从山上升起，将天空染成橙色。

examples.en: Her name is listed above mine on the class roster.
examples.cn: 她的名字在班级名单上列在我的名字之上。

socratic_questions.question: 如果一个物体在另一个物体的上方，我们用什么词来表示这种位置关系？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 表示位置关系，指在...更高的地方。

sentences: The airplane flew ___ the clouds during its journey.

image_prompts: A wise owl perched on a branch, holding a scroll with advice written on it
A road sign showing two different paths, one marked 'Caution' and the other 'Proceed'
words.image_desc_en: An owl giving advice; a road sign showing different paths.
words.image_desc_cn: 一只猫头鹰给出建议；一个路标显示不同的路径。
words.collocations: advise sb. to do sth., advise against doing sth.

examples.en: My parents always advise me to study hard for my exams.
examples.cn: 我的父母总是建议我努力学习，为了我的考试。

examples.en: The doctor advised him to stop smoking for his health.
examples.cn: 医生建议他为了健康戒烟。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你朋友遇到难题，你会怎么做来帮助他？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 提供意见，帮助他做出更好的选择。

sentences: I ___ you to check your work before submitting it.

image_prompts: A pile of dry leaves engulfed in bright orange flames, smoke rising
A scorched piece of toast with black marks, a toaster in the background
words.image_desc_en: Images depicting fire consuming leaves and a burnt toast.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘火焰吞噬树叶和烧焦的吐司的图像。
words.collocations: burn down, burn out, burn up

examples.en: The candle will burn for hours if you don't blow it out.
examples.cn: 如果你不吹灭，蜡烛会燃烧好几个小时。

examples.en: I accidentally burn my hand when I touched the hot stove.
examples.cn: 我不小心碰到热炉子时烧伤了我的手。

socratic_questions.question: 想象一下，木头在高温下会发生什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 描述的是一种物质在高温下发生变化的现象。

sentences: The old house started to ___ after the lightning strike.

image_prompts: A piece of toast with blackened edges, smoke rising slightly
A campfire with glowing embers and charred wood, night scene
words.image_desc_en: Burnt toast and campfire.
words.image_desc_cn: 烤焦的吐司和篝火。
words.usage: adj. / v. (过去式 burnt/burned, 过去分词 burnt/burned)
words.collocations: burnt offering, burnt orange, get burnt
words.preposition_combos: burnt to ashes, burnt beyond recognition

examples.en: The cake was slightly burnt, but it still tasted delicious.
examples.cn: 蛋糕稍微有点烤焦了，但味道仍然很美味。

examples.en: She burnt her hand on the hot stove accidentally yesterday.
examples.cn: 昨天她不小心在热炉子上烫伤了手。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你忘记关火，锅里的食物会变成什么样？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 食物因为高温而变黑，失去原有味道。

sentences: The forest was ___ to the ground by the wildfire last summer.

image_prompts: A pile of charred logs in a fireplace, embers glowing faintly
A piece of toast with a dark, blackened edge, smoke rising
words.image_desc_en: Images depicting something that has been damaged or destroyed by fire.
